facts.fact: Olivia与Tamsin一路跑到主厅才停下。
facts.anchor: We didn’t stop running until we reached the main hall.

facts.fact: Tamsin追问那个叫Olivia“Livvie”的男人是谁。
facts.anchor: He called you Livvie! How does he know you? Who is he?

facts.fact: 两人轮流扑粉、补胭脂，借梳妆恢复镇定。
facts.anchor: We took turns powdering our faces and touching our lips and cheeks with rouge.
“I know your father.” The blond girl’s eyebrows lifted a fraction.

facts.fact: Tallulah把手伸进Olivia裙下并触碰她的大腿。
facts.anchor: Tallulah’s hand slipped under my dress.

facts.fact: Tallulah邀请三人参加Rex后天夜里的Sardines游戏。
facts.anchor: Night after tomorrow, Rex is having his legendary game of Sardines.

facts.fact: Olivia第一次清楚意识到自己想要一种远比现有生活广阔的人生。
facts.anchor: For the first time I could recall, I wanted a life far bigger than the one I had.

facts.fact: Olivia对Tamsin可能杀过人的念头已不如当天早晨那样不安。
facts.anchor: The thought of the possible murders didn’t disturb me as much as it had even that morning.
